:::{#exm-exp-hazard}

#### Hazard of an exponential time at several times

Suppose an event time $T$ is exponential with rate $\lambda = 0.1$ events per year.
The hazard is the density divided by the survival function.
The code below computes it at three times:

```{r}
#| label: exm-exp-hazard-calc
#| code-fold: show
exp_lambda <- 0.1
exp_times <- c(1, 5, 20)
hazards <- dexp(exp_times, rate = exp_lambda) /
  pexp(exp_times, rate = exp_lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
```

The hazards at 1, 5 and 20 years are
`r paste(round(hazards, 4), collapse = ", ")`,
all equal to $\lambda =$ `r exp_lambda`,
as @thm-exp-hazard states.

:::
